question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Much to his astonishment, the once chaotic office was now surprisingly _______________ after the new management took over.
solution:
The correct answer is '**organized**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**organized**" means arranged in a systematic way or made more efficient. (संगठित)
 
• After the new management took over, the chaotic office became structured and orderly.
 
• The other options: "**hectic**," "**disorganised**," and "**tumultuous**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Much to his astonishment, the once chaotic office was now surprisingly organized__ after the new management took over.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hectic (व्यस्त)**: means full of incessant or frantic activity.
 
• **Disorganised (अव्यवस्थित)**: means lacking order or organization.
 
• **Tumultuous (अराजक)**: means characterized by disorderly commotion or noise.
